object: H3-machine-convention: ledger counted in the convention of the organizer count C(r3) = 638
question: R4 score sensitivity of the machine convention (registers, spills, width)
number: Per batch operation: +/-1 operation = +/-0.00241 bit; 10 percent of the batch (59.5 operations) = 0.149 bit. Registers: zero loads/stores need 25 simultaneously live values (exact liveness; list scheduling gives 25 too); at 24 registers +0.0048 bit (2 loads), 20 +0.026, 16 +0.072 (31 extra ops/batch), 12 +0.156, 8 +0.246 (emitted order; Belady eviction). The entry's remark that fewer than about 40 registers would cost is too pessimistic: 25 plus a few control registers suffice. Width: a 512-bit word at the same priced op would be -1.0355 bit (15 lanes of 34, 622 ops, 41.47 per step) if priced as one op; as two ops 0. The convention costs the score at most these amounts; none is a saving on the filed entry.
notes: universe cell blake3-r3|PREM.H3|PREM|R4. Spill counts use Belady eviction on the emitted order (optimal for loads, heuristic for stores) with one operation per load or store; a register-starved machine is not offered by the organizer text (register count is silent).
held_fixed: straight-line batch of 595 + 4 filter operations, loop-carried digest registers, immediates free
reopen_if: organizer text that fixes a register count below 25 or prices a 512-bit word
